summary: Frontend-only test of mystical Russian esoteric Expo app at https://screen-redesign-3.preview.emergentagent.com (mobile viewport 390x844). All 7 review checklist items verified end-to-end including AsyncStorage persistence across reload. No backend (per spec). No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: HistoryContext.streak uses Math.max(s, 3) baseline — minor: this fakes a 3-day streak for new users (acknowledged 'for vibe' in code, not a bug but worth noting).
Home screen 'Карта дня' is deterministic by date (good), and addItem dedupes by todayCardSaved check — works correctly.
seed_data_creation: None (3 seeded HistoryItems created automatically by HistoryProvider on first AsyncStorage hydration).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App served at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://screen-redesign-3.preview.emergentagent.com). Pure local-storage app, no backend APIs. All testIDs match spec exactly. Card flip animation ~700ms, oracle loading ~2s — wait accordingly. Diary outcome buttons use dynamic ids (outcome-fulfilled-<id>, outcome-failed-<id>) — query via [data-testid^='outcome-fulfilled-']. Note: after tarot reset, slots may be below scroll viewport — not a bug.
verified_flows: App loads at / with Home tab default — home-greeting 'Звёзды благосклонны', streak-badge, energy-phrase, card-of-the-day (face down), sign-of-day all visible.
Bottom tab bar shows 4 tabs (tab-home, tab-oracle, tab-tarot, tab-diary). Navigation between tabs works.
Tapping card-of-the-day flips it; card-of-the-day-name reveals (e.g. 'Влюблённые') and 'Карта дня' entry is added to Diary (verified in Diary list).

Oracle: oracle-input accepts text, oracle-ask-btn shows ~2s loading, then oracle-answer renders a random mystical answer (e.g. '«Серьёзно?»' from snarky category with category badge 'С ХАРАКТЕРОМ'). Button text switches to 'Задать новый вопрос'; pressing again resets input='' and answer hidden.

Tarot: tarot-card-slot-0..4 all rendered as fanned spread. Tapping slot 2 reveals picked-card + card-name + card-short + card-detailed. intuition-open-btn opens modal, intuition-input + intuition-save-btn persists 'Я чувствую тепло и надежду' visible above meaning. tarot-reset-btn returns to spread phase.

Diary: diary-list visible with 3 seeded items + new entries from Oracle/Tarot at top. outcome-fulfilled-<id> and outcome-failed-<id> toggle green/red highlight; tapping again toggles off; switching between fulfilled/failed works.
AsyncStorage persistence: after page reload, 3 oracle items with outcome buttons remain (seed-1, seed-3, and the new oracle item created during test) — confirmed state persists.
